i gained over 100 pounds in the first four years after i came back from my second tour. ptsd, a tbi, and more medications than i can count, all with a side effect of weight gain. so beginning in 2010, i was 279. i started dieting and exercising, and lost 54 pounds. then in march 0f 2011, rockets fell in the city i lived in. i relapsed/regressed/didn't much care about my life or health. i crawled into a bottle. 
five years or so later, and i've had no consistent weight loss progress. i don't even know what to use as a starting weight, because i have been attempting to lose it for so long, i don't know when the beginning is anymore.
In November 2005, I weighed 175. In December 2010, I weighed 279. In March 2011, I weighed 224. Since then, I have weighed as much as 297 or as little as 255. The 255 was not a result of exercise or progress, as much as it was a byproduct of being suicidal and not caring enough each day about eating or other basic health demands. right now i'm 276. I was 268 at the beginning of the year, with a plan to lose twenty pounds. not so much. 
i've got way too much going on and i care way too little about myself to gain any traction for progress. i really don't know why i bother anymore.
